in_hebrew.name: Hoy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו River or rich
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hoy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'hoos', meaning 'river'. In the New Testament, the name Hoy is given to several characters, including Hoy of Antioch and Hoy the Centurion. The name is also associated with wealth and abundance.
